A copper alloy finger ring with evidence of silvering or tinning on the surface. The shape is classically Roman with the slightly 'D' shaped hoop as opposed to a circle. The design on the bezel appears to be a crudely incised pair of men fighting with swords; as such it may be considered a military style ring.
